product.label: Our Product
product.name: PICA
product.description: PICA is a Moroccan SaaS platform for intelligent contract management, built for companies, law firms, and legal departments. By combining AI, automation, and deep expertise in Moroccan law, PICA centralizes the entire lifecycle of your contracts — from drafting to archiving — while reducing risk, delays, and costs.

analysis.title: AI-Powered Contract Analysis
analysis.desc: Upload any contract (PDF, Word, ODT) and get within seconds: party identification, clause extraction, obligation detection, global risk scoring, and compliance verification against Moroccan law.

generation.title: Custom Contract Generation
generation.desc: Create professional contracts from legal templates (permanent, fixed-term, service agreements, leases, NDAs...). AI suggests missing or weak clauses before generation.

dashboard.title: Real-Time Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Monitor your contract portfolio: KPIs, lifecycle pipeline, expiry alerts, overdue obligations, risk distribution, and average compliance score.

alerts.title: Smart Alerts & Deadlines
alerts.desc: Automatic detection of upcoming expirations (30, 60, 90 days), tacit renewal deadlines, and overdue obligations — prioritized as critical, high, or normal.

compliance.title: Moroccan Law Compliance
compliance.desc: The only platform calibrated against Moroccan law: Labor Code (65-99), Law 15-95, Law 09-08 on data protection, Code of Obligations and Contracts.

comparison.title: Contract Comparison
comparison.desc: Compare two versions or two different contracts clause by clause. AI identifies added risks, removed clauses, and recommends the most favorable one.

workflow.title: Team Management & Approval Workflows
workflow.desc: Assign contracts to legal, finance, or operational teams. Manage submission, approval, and signing workflows with full audit trail.

bilingual.title: Arabic / French Bilingual Support
bilingual.desc: Native processing of contracts in Arabic, French, or both. Extraction, classification, and analysis work in Arabic with native RTL display.

reports.title: Automated Reporting
reports.desc: Generate Excel/PDF reports in one click: contract portfolio, risk analysis, deadlines, compliance report — ready for your board or executive committee.
